instruction: Studio-To-Four-Room Layout Use the opened Bonsai IFC authoring environment to modify the provided /home/user/Desktop/init.ifc studio model into a four-room layout. You may use /home/user/Desktop/init_plan.png as a local reference image. Save the completed IFC4 model as /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc. Keep one project, one site, one building, and one storey named Ground Floor. The final model must contain four spaces, seven walls, one slab, four doors, two windows, six openings, six void relationships, and six fill relationships. Do not include proxies, furniture, roofs, columns, beams, stairs, or flow terminals, and keep every IfcRoot GlobalId unique. Create spaces named Living, Kitchen, Bedroom, and Bath. Their clear plan sizes must be Living 3.60 m by 3.50 m, Kitchen 3.60 m by 1.65 m, Bedroom 3.50 m by 2.70 m, and Bath 2.70 m by 2.45 m, with all spaces 3.00 m high. Name the slab Base Slab and make it 8.00 m by 6.00 m by 0.20 m. Name the walls South Wall, East Wall, North Wall, West Wall, Partition 1, Partition 2, and Partition 3. Their dimensions must be 8.00 m by 0.20 m by 3.00 m for South and North, 0.20 m by 6.00 m by 3.00 m for East and West, 0.15 m by 5.60 m by 3.00 m for Partition 1, 3.80 m by 0.15 m by 3.00 m for Partition 2, and 3.00 m by 0.15 m by 3.00 m for Partition 3. Add openings and fillings named Main Entrance in South Wall at 1.00 m by 0.20 m by 2.10 m, North Window in North Wall at 1.50 m by 0.20 m by 1.20 m, East Window in East Wall at 1.50 m by 0.20 m by 1.20 m, Door Bedroom in Partition 1 at 0.80 m by 0.15 m by 2.10 m, Door Kitchen in Partition 2 at 0.80 m by 0.15 m by 2.10 m, and Door Bath in Partition 3 at 0.80 m by 0.15 m by 2.10 m. Assign all spaces, walls, the slab, doors, and windows to Ground Floor. Other representation details may vary. [Software] Bonsai workflows are used together with Blender; start Blender with `blender` (adjust path if needed).
